title: Cross-judge agreement report v1
description: The `--output` of `eval judge agreement`: how well the judges (and the stored measures of an answers file) agree on the same answers. `judge_temperature` is added by the command.

run_id.description: The envelope: the id of the run that saved this file (dokimi.artifacts.run_id). Absent from files saved before the envelope.

dokimi_version.description: The envelope: the dokimi version that saved this file. Absent from files saved before the envelope.

summary.description: The measures compared and their agreement.

unscored.description: The measures that scored no answer: `measure`, `kind`, `asked`, `unscored`, `first_error`.
